description: This file contains the implementation of the FreeCheckout class, which extends the base Model class in the OpenCart system. The class provides a method to retrieve available payment methods, specifically the 'free_checkout' option, within the OpenCart extension framework.

classes.name: FreeCheckout
classes.description: A model class responsible for providing payment method options, specifically for the free checkout process.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods based on the current cart and session status, returning an array of method options.
